data.name: Aznah
data.gender_notes: Aznah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘azana’, meaning to delight or please. In Islamic tradition, Aznah represents the joy and radiance that comes from living a righteous and obedient life. The name is often given to girls in the hope that they will bring happiness and delight to their families and communities. The name Aznah carries the meaning “Delight, Joy, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aznah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Aznah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aznah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
